newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Gas Natural to effect free capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Spain Gas Natural to effect free capital increase.

text.p: Spain's Gas Natural said it will propose a share split and free capital increase at its next shareholders meeting to improve the liquidity of its shares, a local news agency reported late Monday.
No one was immediately avaliable on Tuesday morning to confirm the news.
According to Efe news agency, Gas Natural intends to divide the nominal share value by four.
The shareholders capital will then be raised from 22.39 billion pesetas to 74.63 billion charging it to reserves.
After the split the number of shares will increase to 149,258,670 from 37,314,669.
When approved the move will divide share nominal value by four from 600 pesetas each to 150 pesetas each, with the nominal value then rising to 500 pesetas following the free capital increase.
